title: Owens tries to sway football games while drinking

tellings.quote: He would uh occasionally sit in his living room smoking cigars and drinking whiskey and he'd have two or three TV sets going with football games and he would try and influence the outcome of the football games from a a state of intoxication.

plain: A self-proclaimed psychic named Ted Owens would sit in his living room smoking cigars and drinking whiskey, with two or three televisions showing football games, and try to change how the games turned out with his mind while drunk. The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove tells this as something he learned about Owens, set in the 1970s and 1980s, as a picture of how Owens tested his claimed powers.
